constraint_text: The AI agent must obtain all information by calling the provided tools, and it is restricted to at most 2 calls per tool for each of event_locator, museum_exhibit_locator, historical_artisan_finder, historical_site_finder, altitude_finder, bird_characteristic_finder, car_design_influence_finder, and car_specification_retriever. The agent must complete the task in at most 16 interaction rounds and must not exceed 12 total tool calls across all rounds. The final response must end with the identifier "[Answer]".
